extracted.intended_audience: aspiring improvisers, sketch-comedy writers and performers, prospective students, and educators seeking training or workshops at The Second City Training Center (Chicago).
extracted.subtask_description: Information and guidelines about courses, workshops, and programs for learning improvisation and sketch comedy at The Second City Training Center in Chicago. Targets both beginners and experienced performers, as well as educators and youth programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Second City traditions and techniques
rubrics_metrics.description: The Training Center follows the traditions developed by these groundbreaking and innovative men and women while encouraging the continued growth and development of the art forms of comedy and improvisation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training is rooted in fifty years of Second City practice and the comedic material created by its performers; instruction emphasizes those established traditions while fostering ongoing innovation in improv and sketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open to all experience levels
rubrics_metrics.description: We offer a variety of classes in the performance arts for students at any level of experience. Whether a seasoned performer or someone who's never been onstage, you are encouraged to take classes with us.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course offerings are structured to accommodate beginners through advanced students; potential students are encouraged to enroll regardless of prior experience and to contact the offices with questions or concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support individual student goals and skill growth
rubrics_metrics.description: Our students come from a diverse array of backgrounds, each with a unique accomplishment they wish to achieve with our courses. Whatever your reasons for taking classes with us, we are here to support you and help you grow your skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction and coursework are meant to be responsive to students' individual aims—technical skill-building and personal development are core outcomes emphasized by the Training Center.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing Program fundamentals
rubrics_metrics.description: Watch a video about the Writing Program, featuring our beloved Mary Scruggs talking about the fundamentals of the program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Writing Program covers foundational elements of comedic writing; further program details are available via the Writing Program page and video resources linked from the catalog.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short-format intensives and targeted workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples of offerings include 'Yes Yes Y'all: A Rap Workshop', 'An Improviser's Intro to Voiceover', and 'Three-Day Intensives — Basic training in three days for adults.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Training Center provides focused workshops and short intensives aimed at specific skills or genres (voiceover, rap-based comedy, etc.), suitable for adults seeking concentrated, time-limited skill-building.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workshops for educators and K-12 students
rubrics_metrics.description: Unique curriculum based workshops and performances that enrich the work of thousands of K-12 students and educators each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These offerings are curriculum-aligned and intended to support educators and student learning through performance-based workshops and school-focused performances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Show and performance design services
rubrics_metrics.description: Let Second City design a show or performance for you. Or, we’ll just come play one of our best current shows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Training Center/Second City offers production and design services for custom shows as well as the option to present existing Second City productions for client events or engagements.
